title: Surendra Kumar v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
coram: Sangeeta Chandra and Subhash Vidyarthi, JJ.
disposition: Reply to provisional assessment directed; recovery kept in abeyance.
headnote: Writ disposed of by directing the petitioner to file, within one week, a reply to the provisional assessment addressed to the Executive Engineer. On that reply the Executive Engineer shall pass a final assessment order within four weeks. Recovery on the recovery certificate stays in abeyance for five weeks or until that decision, whichever is later.
facts: On 6 September 2023 the petitioner's premises were raided and an FIR was lodged alleging theft of electricity. Opposite party no. 4 issued a recovery citation dated 9 August 2024. The petitioner said no notice under Section 3 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 had been served, and that the Tehsil was recovering dues although no final assessment order existed. The licensee said a provisional assessment had issued and that the petitioner had written to the Managing Director rather than the Executive Engineer.

holding_units.topic: Reply to provisional assessment and abeyance of recovery until final order
holding_units.holding: The petition is disposed of with a direction that the petitioner submit, within one week, a reply to the provisional assessment addressed to the Executive Engineer (opposite party no. 2). If that reply is filed, the Executive Engineer shall consider it and pass a final assessment order within a further four weeks. Recovery proceedings on the recovery certificate shall remain in abeyance for five weeks or until that decision, whichever is later.
holding_units.flag: Section 3 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 appears only in the petitioner's plea of non-service of notice. The Court did not construe or apply that clause. The clause number is not reassigned.

principle_tags.application: The petitioner invoked non-service of a Section 3 notice and the absence of a final assessment. The Court left Section 3 undecided and directed a reply to the provisional assessment, a final assessment by the Executive Engineer within four weeks, and abeyance of recovery until that decision.

not_decided.point: Whether notice under Section 3 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was required or served.
not_decided.note: Recorded as the petitioner's case and not adjudicated.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner had committed theft of electricity and what sum is assessable.
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer's final assessment order.

not_decided.point: Whether the recovery citation dated 9 August 2024 was liable to be quashed.
not_decided.note: Recovery was kept in abeyance. The citation was not quashed.
